title: Sentinel Waiver Record
description: Static shape for a filed waiver INSTANCE (as distinct from a rule record's `exceptions` field, which documents built-in exceptions the rule itself always had). Introduced in S1 remediation cycle 1 (S1-F003) because no waiver schema/validator existed even though the waiver template referenced one. Descriptive only -- no runtime consumes this schema. Remediation cycle 2 (S1-F003) added paulo_decision_ref/architect_sync_ref: the JSON Schema declares them as optional strings because whether either is REQUIRED depends on the target rule's own authority fields in ../rules/*.json, which this schema cannot see -- that conditional binding is enforced by validate-waivers.mjs, not expressible as a static schema constraint here.

rule_waived.description: Must reference an existing rule_id in ../rules/*.json whose 'waivable' field is true. validate-waivers.mjs checks both conditions against the current rule registry.

approver.description: Must be Paulo, or a role Paulo has explicitly pre-authorized to approve waivers of this rule's class -- never the requesting actor.

expires_at.description: MANDATORY -- there are no permanent silent exceptions. validate-waivers.mjs rejects any waiver record missing this field or where it is not strictly after issued_at.

evidence.description: Evidence class(es) supporting that the compensating controls actually work.

paulo_decision_ref.description: S1-F003 (cycle 2): a brain/DECISION_LOG.md entry ID (or equivalent explicit Paulo record) evidencing Paulo's approval of this specific waiver. validate-waivers.mjs REQUIRES this field, non-empty, whenever the waived rule's authority.paulo_approval_required is true -- an arbitrary 'approver' string is not itself sufficient authority evidence for such a rule.

architect_sync_ref.description: S1-F003 (cycle 2): an Architect Sync ID (e.g. ML-DEVOS-AS-NNN) evidencing Architect review of this specific waiver. validate-waivers.mjs REQUIRES this field, non-empty, whenever the waived rule's authority.architect_sync_required is true.
